notes.title: Everlasting Flowers Update Notification
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889538/f2b2bda272f6e835804b035cad7a0c3b28104d8c.jpg[/img]

Everlasting Flowers Ver. 1.07

・The menu at the top right of the screen will temporarily disappear after 5 seconds when the mouse cursor is inactive (returns with mouse movement).
・Improved mouse wheel operation (enhanced behavior when scrolling forward, back, and in auto mode).
・Performance improvements for certain environments.

Thank you to everyone who contributed to the improvement of these features.

notes.title: Everlasting Flowers Ver. 1.06 Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889538/e799c7ea17fd206f023c0bf6ea19f3dd90ab344e.png[/img]

	•	We have added support for toggling AUTO mode (automatic text forwarding) on and off using the F4 key on the keyboard.
	•	We have fixed an issue where the title screen was not being counted towards playtime; it will now be included in the playtime count.
	•	The game has been adjusted to operate offline.
	•	For SteamDeck users, the resolution at first launch has been changed to 1280x720px.

(We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to Mr. A.K. for his valuable advice, which prompted these improvements.)

We will continue to add and improve features on an ongoing basis.
